decision.explanation: Document d00 explicitly identifies Tyler Moore (born 1993) as an American football offensive guard; document d05 identifies Tyler Michael Moore (born 1987) as a professional baseball player; and document d06 describes a Tyler Moore competing in the NAPF Bench Press Championships, confirming an association with bench press. The basketball references in documents d03 and d04 refer to a different entity (William Moore or a generic context) or lack specific biographical confirmation for the named Tyler Moore, so they are excluded.
